import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem bounded_unit_circle_power_series_hasSum
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (a : ℕ → ℂ) (B : ℝ) 
    (hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖a n‖ ≤ B) :
    ∃ y : ℂ, HasSum (fun n : ℕ => a n * z ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1 : ℂ) ^ p) y := by
  have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hbound 0)
  have hp_real : (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have h_neg : (-(p : ℝ)) < -1 := by linarith
  have h_summable_rpow : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-(p : ℝ))) :=
    Real.summable_nat_rpow.mpr h_neg
  have h_summable_shift : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(p : ℝ))) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-(p : ℝ))) 1).mpr h_summable_rpow
  have h_summable_B : Summable (fun n : ℕ => B * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(p : ℝ)))) :=
    h_summable_shift.mul_left B
  have h_eq : ∀ n : ℕ, B * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(p : ℝ))) = B / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p) := by
    intro n
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have h1 : (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(p : ℝ))) = ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ))⁻¹) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (le_of_lt hpos)]
    have h2 : (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ)) = (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [h1, h2, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have h_summable_real : Summable (fun n : ℕ => B / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p)) := by
    have h' : (fun n : ℕ => B / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p)) = (fun n : ℕ => B * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(p : ℝ)))) := by
      funext n
      rw [h_eq n]
    rw [h']
    exact h_summable_B
  have h_norm_z_pow : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ = 1 := by
    intro n
    rw [norm_pow, hz, one_pow]
  have h_norm_nat_pow : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖((n + 1 : ℂ) ^ p)‖ = (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p) := by
    intro n
    rw [norm_pow]
    have hcast : (n + 1 : ℂ) = (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [hcast, Complex.norm_natCast]
  have h_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖a n * z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1 : ℂ) ^ p)‖ ≤ B / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p) := by
    intro n
    have h1 : ‖a n * z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1 : ℂ) ^ p)‖ = ‖a n‖ * ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ / ‖((n + 1 : ℂ) ^ p)‖ := by
      rw [norm_div, norm_mul]
    rw [h1, h_norm_z_pow n, mul_one, h_norm_nat_pow n]
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p) := by positivity
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hbound n) (le_of_lt hpos)
  have hSummable : Summable (fun n : ℕ => a n * z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1 : ℂ) ^ p)) := by
    apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (g := fun n : ℕ => B / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p)) h_summable_real
    intro n
    exact h_bound n
